title: The Day Meat Fell From the Sky in Kentucky
topic: The Day Meat Fell From the Sky in Kentucky
format_note: Historical-mystery Short, 28 s by the user's choice (72 words, one farmyard, three people). Overrides the 50-60 s explainer targets on purpose.
mechanism: Under a clear sky on 3 March 1876, flakes of animal tissue fell on the Crouch farm in Bath County; the most cited explanation (Kastenbine, 1876) is vultures disgorging food overhead, but no witness mentions birds and it was never proven.

beats.hook: Clear blue sky; one small pink flake drops through frame onto the grass. MEAT FROM THE SKY?
beats.story: Mrs. Crouch stirs her soap kettle in the yard; a flake lands by her hand; she looks up
beats.rise: Wide shot: a few more flakes fall on the yard and stick to the worm fence under a cloudless sky. NO CLOUDS. NO STORM.
beats.twist: LATER: two neighbours arrive, inspect a piece; one hesitantly tastes it, startled face
beats.mechanism: Camera rises to the sky: tiny vulture silhouettes circle far away. ONE THEORY: VULTURES. (a theory, not proven)
beats.ending: The birds fade out, camera settles back on the quiet yard and kettle. WHAT REALLY HAPPENED? Music cuts.

seed.what: The empty clear sky above the farm (where the theory's vultures would be)
